entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The adult man in the center foreground with side-parted brown hair and a thin handlebar mustache, wearing an open-front dark purple long coat, white shirt, black bow tie, gray waistcoat, and light gray trousers, supporting a small notebook in front of him and holding a pen.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The young man following Person A, wearing a dark purple cylindrical hat with two lines of light-gold lettering on the front and a dark purple uniform.

entities.name: red patterned carpet
entities.identification: The carpet in the lobby passageway with a light pink rectangular area, a red border band, and a light-colored patterned border.

entities.name: large potted palm
entities.identification: The tall plant in front of the column on the left, with dark green feathery leaves spreading outward and clustered stems.

entities.name: Person C
entities.identification: The adult man entering from the left foreground, with dark hair and a prominent mustache above his upper lip, wearing a dark long coat and white shirt and holding a light-colored slip of paper.

entities.name: cream-pink wall and arched niche
entities.identification: The light warm-colored walls at the rear and on the right side of the lobby, with rectangular outlines and arched areas.

entities.name: golden-brown stone-faced column
entities.identification: The tall golden-brown-faced column behind the plant on the left, with irregular light and dark textures, dark vertical lines, and a dark base.

entities.name: warm-white globe lights and wall lights
entities.identification: The groups of globe lights hanging above the lobby, the small lights arranged along the edges of the arches, and the fixtures beside the walls.

entities.name: wood-framed upholstered chair in the lobby
entities.identification: The dark wood-framed armchairs with light beige or light brown upholstery in the lobby lounge area, recorded as a group.

entities.name: small round table in the lobby
entities.identification: The dark brown small round tables near the seats on the right side of the lobby, recorded as a group.

entities.name: guests and staff in the background
entities.identification: The collection of people standing, passing by, or seated at the rear and on both sides of the lobby, excluding Person A, Person B, and Person C.

entities.name: metallic round flowerpot
entities.identification: The brown-and-gold nearly cylindrical planter beneath the palm on the left.

entities.name: light-colored ceiling
entities.identification: The flat light pinkish-white ceiling surface above the lobby, with straight borders, beam edges, and decorative lines.

entities.name: geometric-patterned floor
entities.identification: The floor exposed outside the red carpet, with a light-colored ground and dark repeating geometric patterns.

entities.name: cups and saucers on the tabletop
entities.identification: The light-colored cups and saucers and small reflective vessels on the tables in the right-side lounge area, recorded as a group.
